capabilities: Reply to and react to comments
Jump between quotes and source text
extras: Interface is Simplified Chinese only and the plugin runs on desktop only. Comments are stored locally in data.json (back it up alongside the vault) and are not sent to any server; designed for personal use. Anchors use quoted text plus nearby words, so discussions stay accessible in the sidebar when a quote is removed or becomes ambiguous.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach threaded comments and discussions to specific passages within a note.
summary: Annotation plugin that attaches local discussion threads, replies, and reactions to selected text or whole notes in a sidebar.
